definitions.content: Catalytic activity of a component divided by the volume of the original system.

notes.content: The derived coherent SI unit is the mole per second per cubic metre (mol/(s·m^3)), also called kat/m^3. In laboratory medicine the mole per second per litre (mol/(s·L)) is also frequently used.
Throughout this Recommendation the "component" is an enzyme and the "original system" can be, e.g., the plasma of a blood sample.
